study: outcome-adaptive per-arm C-TMLE with a parametric outcome

configuration.outcome_learner: ParametricOutcome: unpenalized logistic GLM on [A indicators, W, A x W] (quasi-binomial on the scaled outcome when q_bounds is declared)
configuration.treatment_learner: ParametricMechanism: per arm, unpenalized logistic regression of 1{A = a} on the cubic in l = logit(clip(Qbar(a, W), 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6)); the kappa cell also fits the linear basis
configuration.comparator: none: Python property evidence, no comparator
configuration.comparator_reason: drtmle's adapt_g reports the shipped curve, so no R program measures the corrected curve; R parity of the point estimate carries through test_parametric_learners.py
configuration.budget_rule: predictive rule with tau_80 = 0.0080 pooled over the study's gated rows; each row centred on its own pilot SE ratio with variance s^2 + tau_80^2; each of the 12 gated calibration groups sized to the smallest multiple of 400 with pass probability >= 0.95 ** (1 / 12), so the study passes with probability >= 0.95; sharp_null and power are sized in this module's BUDGETS comment

failure_bounds.applied: 0.01 in both phases: a cell may lose floor(0.01 R) replicates, and each clause is judged by its worst case over the lost values; one more lost replicate reads bound exceeded. A fit that raises, and an admitted fit whose stack status is not influence_curve, both count as failed replicates

configuration.calibration_efficiency_ratio: False: the noise control reads the SE-ratio rule, and no cell claims a ratio against an efficiency bound
configuration.declared_reading: A red calibration row is finite-sample only under the AGENT-BRIEF rule (its 99% SE-ratio interval contains 1, its coverage is consistent with 0.95, and diagnosis finds no defect). shipped_curve_control and cross_term_dropped_control must be red, that is, their SE-ratio intervals must leave the calibration band below and above. The harness publishes passed=True for such a control. If either control stays inside or straddles the band, its cell cannot see its term, the study is invalid, and it is redesigned before any reading. The coverage of psi_0 in the pseudo-true cell, the sqrt(n) SD of the ladder and the Monte Carlo covariance of the arm means are reported and gate nothing.
configuration.publication_reading: gated: every row must pass, and a negative control passes by being red
configuration.family_mapping: the ladder and the joint cells are interval_calibration cells named <label>__<estimand>__corrected, so the shared calibration verdict applies per estimand; the covariance is reported on the shared-prognosis ate row
configuration.failure_probe: pilot of 5,000 draws per cell (plan section 11): no separation refusal, no stack failure, largest recomputed-Q* gap 4.4e-16
